test_title: PYST 39: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 01 Mar, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: maths
question: The selling price of an article is Rs. 1482. If discount of 22 percent is given, then what will be the marked price of the article?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price of the article = Rs. 1482

Discount given = 22%

**Formula Used:**

Marked Price = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

**Calculation:**

Discount Rate = 22% = 0.22

Marked Price = Selling Price / (1 - Discount Rate)

Marked Price = 1482 / (1 - 0.22)

Marked Price = 1482 / 0.78

Marked Price = 1900

**The marked price of the article is Rs. 1900.**
